summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide the full lifecycle for building AI systems: data preparation, distributed training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment/serving, and monitoring at scale. You need one when you are training or fine-tuning custom models, managing many experiments and model versions, enforcing governance, or serving models in production with scaling, security, and reproducibility requirements — whereas simply calling a hosted model API (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock) is sufficient when you only consume pre-built models without owning the training or MLOps lifecycle. In 2026 the landscape has consolidated around cloud-native suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) and data-intelligence platforms (Databricks), with specialized MLOps and infrastructure players (W&B, Modal) filling gaps.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute/storage/endpoint hour; no upfront cost; SageMaker AI is the managed ML service within the broader SageMaker data & AI environment
platforms.best_for: Teams deeply invested in the AWS ecosystem needing a modular, AWS-native ML workshop with tight S3/IAM integration

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per node/compute hour and per prediction; generative AI priced per token
platforms.best_for: Organizations on GCP wanting unified AutoML, custom training, and first-class access to Gemini and foundation models

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute/VM hour and managed endpoint; no platform surcharge beyond underlying resources
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing governance, responsible-AI tooling, and Azure OpenAI integration

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBUs (Databricks Units) on top of cloud compute; multi-cloud flexible
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting unified data, analytics, ML, and GenAI governance on a lakehouse with multi-cloud flexibility

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage-based team and enterprise plans; self-hosted available
platforms.best_for: ML/AI research and engineering teams that need best-in-class experiment tracking and MLOps observability across any training stack

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription / contact sales; consumption and seat-based tiers
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and business analysts wanting automated model building and governed deployment with minimal hand-coding

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; Driverless AI and enterprise cloud via subscription/contact sales
platforms.best_for: Data science teams wanting open-source-rooted AutoML plus enterprise generative AI with on-prem options

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second compute billing for CPU/GPU; free starter credits
platforms.best_for: ML engineers wanting code-first serverless GPU infrastructure for training and deploying without managing clusters

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free tier; Pro subscription; pay-as-you-go Inference Endpoints and Spaces compute; enterprise plans
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source and transformer models needing the hub, fine-tuning, and managed inference endpoints

platforms.name: Amazon Bedrock
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token (on-demand) and provisioned throughput; customization billed separately
platforms.best_for: Enterprises on AWS wanting managed access to and customization of foundation models for GenAI apps without infra management

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free open source; cost is the underlying Kubernetes/cloud infrastructure
platforms.best_for: Platform teams wanting portable, Kubernetes-native MLOps pipelines without cloud-vendor lock-in
